## Uninstall

Installed with the setup: open Settings, Apps, Installed apps, and uninstall VRCFaceTracking. That removes the app, its Start menu entry and its SteamVR registration. It then asks whether to delete your settings, installed modules and logs too. Answer No if you also use the Steam version, because it reads the same settings and modules.

Extracted by hand: close VRCFaceTracking and delete the folder. Settings and modules stay in `%AppData%\VRCFaceTracking` and logs in `%LocalAppData%\VRCFaceTracking\logs`. Delete those two folders too for a clean removal.
